c.v: If the setup time requirements for the input or output data signal are not met, users can specify the clock phase, as shown in the figure 34.10-1.
This issue can be fixed by configuring register

For example, set CCLKIN_EDGE_DRV_SEL bit to 0 to drive the output data in phase0, and set the CCLKIN_EDGE_SAM_SEL bit to 1 to select phase90 to sample the data from SDIO slave, if there are still timing issue, please set bit 4 or 6 to use phase180 or phase 270 to sample the data from SDIO slave.
Please find detailed information on the clock phase selection register
